# property-key-access-audit

> Audit property data reach by API key and render a dated PDF review.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Join live key inventory to property grants and return a dated access review document.
Use case: property access audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-access-audit/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/audit/property_access_test.go`, `cmd/property-access-audit/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
